organization.name: Combine Foundation
organization.tagline: Making a difference, one person at a time
organization.legalStatus: Non-profit organization (NPO) registered under the Companies Act 2017; the philanthropic arm of Combine Group
organization.about: Combine Foundation works to uplift underprivileged and marginalised communities by improving their access to quality healthcare and education, through practical support and collaboration with local partners.
organization.mission: To uplift underprivileged and marginalised communities by improving their access to quality healthcare and education, creating sustainable change that empowers people to lead healthier, more educated, and more independent lives.
organization.vision: A Pakistan where every person, regardless of background or income, has access to quality healthcare and education.

contact.address: Plot 9, 10, 11 & 21, Sector E-V, Phase II, K.E.P.Z, Karachi, Pakistan

programs.title: Hunger Relief
programs.description: Food support for individuals and families who struggle to afford daily meals.

programs.title: Disaster Relief
programs.description: Quick response to natural disasters and emergencies with supplies, medical aid, and essential support.

programs.title: Homeless Assistance
programs.description: Shelter, clothing, and support services to help people find safety and stability.

programs.title: Education Support
programs.description: Scholarships, financial aid, and course sponsorships for students from disadvantaged backgrounds.

programs.title: Health Care Access
programs.description: Free or subsidised healthcare: medications, checkups, health camps, and medical test sponsorships.

educationWork: Scholarships for talented students who can't afford to continue their education
Partial or full payment of university and college fees
Scholarships for foreign studies, with a commitment to serve back to the nation
Vocational training and skill development, especially for youth and women
Computer literacy and digital access: computer centers and basic IT training
Support for schools and learning centers in underserved areas
healthWork: Donations and aid during natural disasters and emergencies
Support for hospitals, nursing homes, childcare centers, clinics, dispensaries, and vaccination centers
Awareness programs on healthy food, lifestyle, hygiene, and preventive care
Seasonal programs: warm clothes and blankets in winter, hygiene kits in summer
Advocacy for a cleaner environment as a foundation for public health
